        在实际业务场景中，一个AI工作流的多个步骤之间往往需要共享上下文数据，例如用户原始输入、模型的输出缓存等。在MAF中，提供了一个 WorkflowContext 的模型，它原生提供了工作流上下文的状态共享能力。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span><span>大家好，我是Edison。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>最近我一直在跟着圣杰的《<a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzA4NzQzNTg4Ng==&amp;mid=2651744458&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=139f7584e81aeecd0945133bdc2b4791&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow"><span>.NET+AI智能体开发进阶</span></a><span>》课程学习MAF的开发技巧，我强烈推荐你也上车跟我一起出发！</span></span></span></p>
<p><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/edisontalk/p/-/quick-start-on-maf-chatper06" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2"><span>上一篇</span></a><span>，我们学习了MAF中进行了Agent和Executor的混合编排<span>，相信你一定有了更多地理解。本篇，我们来通过一个经典的例子了解下MAF中工作流如何实现状态的共享。</span></span></span></p>
<h1><strong>状态共享的应用场景</strong></h1>
<p><span><span><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>在实际业务场景中，一个AI工作流的多个步骤之间往往需要共享上下文数据，例如用户原始输入、模型的输出缓存等<span>。<span><strong>在MAF中，提供了一个 WorkflowContext 的模型，它原生提供了工作流上下文的状态共享能力</strong><span>。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p>举个例子，在下面这个聚合统计流程中，创建了一个FileContentState的共享内容通过WorkflowContext进行传递共享给后续的两个统计Executor使用，进而进行聚合输出结果。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251217185839212-187740423.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<h1><strong>WorkflowContext API一览</strong></h1>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>在WorkflowContext API中，它提供了以下一些状态读取和设置的接口，作为字典我们可以了解一下：</span></span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251217185901993-1455682153.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>这里我们用的比较多的是：QueueStateUpdateAsync 和 ReadStateAsync 两个方法。</span></span></span></p>
<h1><strong>实验案例</strong></h1>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span><span>今天来实践一个文档统计的工作流案例，和上面的例子相似：</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251217185945960-911226028.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span><span><span><span>这是一个典型的<span><strong>扇入扇出（Fan-In &amp; Fan-Out）</strong><span>工作流：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span><span><span><span>首先，用户输入一个文件名，FileReadExecutor会读取该文件的内容并将文件内容传入工作流上下文中共享，同时将文件ID号传递给后续流程。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span><span><span><span>然后，单词统计Executor 和 段落统计Executor 会分别统计该文件内容的 单词数 和 段落数。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span><span><span><span>最后，聚合统计Executor会将收集到的 单词数 和 段落数 交由LLM进行友好信息的输出，最初反馈给用户。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span><span><span><span>这个案例展示了<span><strong>一次写入，多处读取</strong><span>的经典场景，它也是并发协作的基础。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2><strong>准备工作</strong></h2>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span>在今天的这个案例中，我们仍然创建了一个.NET控制台应用程序，安装了以下NuGet包：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li><span>Microsoft.Agents.AI.OpenAI</span></li>
<li><span>Microsoft.Agents.AI.Workflows</span></li>
<li><span>Microsoft.Extensions.AI.OpenAI</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span><span><span><span><span><span><span>我们的配置文件中定义了LLM API的信息：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OpenAI</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">EndPoint</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://api.siliconflow.cn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ApiKey</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">******************************</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ModelId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>这里我们使用 SiliconCloud 提供<span><span>的<span><span>&nbsp;<span><span>Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507&nbsp;<span><span>模型，之前的 Qwen2.5 模型在这个案例中不适用。你<span><span>可以通过这个URL注册账号：<span><span><a href="https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/i/DomqCefW" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/i/DomqCefW</a><span>&nbsp;获取大量免费的Token来进行本次实验。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>然后，我们将配置文件中的API信息读取出来：</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> config = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConfigurationBuilder()
    .AddJsonFile($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">appsettings.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, optional: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>, reloadOnChange: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    .Build();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> openAIProvider = config.GetSection(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">OpenAI</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).Get&lt;OpenAIProvider&gt;();</pre>
</div>
<h2><span>定义数据传输模型</span></h2>
<p><span><span>首先，我们定义一下在这个工作流中需要生成传递的数据模型：</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>（1）FileStats ：统计结果DTO</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FileStats
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> WordCount { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; init; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> ParagraphCount { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; init; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>（2）FileContentStateConstants ：常量，类似于Cache Key的作用</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FileContentStateConstants
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> ScopeName = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">FileContentState</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h2 data-pm-slice="2 3 []"><span>定义示例数据集</span></h2>
<p>这里我们Mock了一个文档数据集，用于模拟读取的文件内容。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SharedStateSampleData
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> IReadOnlyDictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt; Documents = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Dictionary&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        [</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ProductBrief</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MAF Workflow 让 .NET 团队可以像积木一样组合 Agent、Executor 与工具, 支持流式事件、并发节点和可观测性。\n\n它强调企业级能力, 包括状态管理、依赖注入、权限控制, 适合搭建端到端 AI 业务流程。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        [</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">WeeklyReport</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">本周平台完成了 Shared State 功能的代码走查, 已经覆盖 Fan-out/Fan-in, Loop, Human-in-the-Loop 三种场景。\n\n下周计划: 1) 集成多模型投票; 2) 增加异常回滚; 3) 落地监控指标。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    };
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> GetDocument(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> name)
        </span>=&gt; Documents.TryGetValue(name, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> content)
            </span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> content
            : </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> ArgumentException($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">未找到文档: {name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h2><span>文件读取Executor</span></h2>
<p>MAF中定义了一个Executor的基类，所有自定义Exectuor都需要继承于它。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> FileReadExecutor() : Executor&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">FileReadExecutor</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> ValueTask&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt; HandleAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> message, IWorkflowContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> content =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SharedStateSampleData.GetDocument(message);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> fileId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">N</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.QueueStateUpdateAsync(fileId, content, 
            FileContentStateConstants.ScopeName, cancellationToken);
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">📦 FileReadExecutor 已成功将 {message} 写入 Scope:{FileContentStateConstants.ScopeName}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> fileId;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span><span>在这个Executor中，接收了用户的输入文件名，然后模拟从Mock文档内容中读取文件内容，并将文件ID 和 文件内容 通过 QueueStateUpdateAsync 方法传入共享状态存储区中，以便后续节点在需要的时候可以从共享状态中读取传递的内容。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>最后，将文件ID直接传递给下一个节点。</span></span></p>
<h2 data-pm-slice="2 3 []"><span>文字统计 和 段落统计Executor</span></h2>
<p>这里我们弄了两个用于统计文件内容的Executor，演示一下如何通过 ReadStateAsync 方法读取共享状态存储区中的内容。<br><strong>（1）文字统计</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> WordCountingExecutor() : Executor&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, FileStats&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">WordCountingExecutor</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> ValueTask&lt;FileStats&gt; HandleAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> fileId, IWorkflowContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? content = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> context.ReadStateAsync&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(fileId, FileContentStateConstants.ScopeName, cancellationToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (content <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">无法在 Scope:{FileContentStateConstants.ScopeName} 中找到 fileId={fileId}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> wordCount = content.Split([<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\r</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">], StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).Length;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> FileStats { WordCount =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> wordCount };
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;text-transform: none;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;white-space: normal;text-align: left;line-height: 1.75em;margin-bottom: 8px;margin-top: 8px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>（2）段落统计</span></span></strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> ParagraphCountingExecutor() : Executor&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, FileStats&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ParagraphCountingExecutor</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> ValueTask&lt;FileStats&gt; HandleAsync(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> fileId, IWorkflowContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? content = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> context.ReadStateAsync&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(fileId, FileContentStateConstants.ScopeName, cancellationToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (content <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> InvalidOperationException($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">无法在 Scope:{FileContentStateConstants.ScopeName} 中找到 fileId={fileId}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> paragraphCount = content.Split([<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\r</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">], StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).Length;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> FileStats { ParagraphCount =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> paragraphCount };
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h2 data-pm-slice="2 3 []"><span>聚合输出Executor</span></h2>
<p>在工作流最后，我们定义给一个聚合输出的节点来汇总和输出用户友好的统计结果，这里我们首先获取到结构化的统计结果，然后通过LLM让其根据结果输出最终的反馈信息：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> AggregationExecutor : Executor&lt;FileStats&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AIAgent _aggregationAgent;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AgentThread _thread;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> List&lt;FileStats&gt; _buffer =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [];
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> AggregationExecutor(IChatClient chatClient) : <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">AggregationExecutor</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建 Agent 和对话线程</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._aggregationAgent =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> chatClient.CreateAIAgent(
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是一个专业的文档统计结果输出大师，你可以将收到的JSON格式统计结果（如总词数、总段落数 以及 统计时间等）进行友好的信息输出给用户。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">output_agent</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Output user friendly message based on input document stats result</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">); ;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._thread = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">._aggregationAgent.GetNewThread();
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> ValueTask HandleAsync(FileStats message, IWorkflowContext context, CancellationToken cancellationToken = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">._buffer.Add(message);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._buffer.Count &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> totalWords = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._buffer.Sum(x =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x.WordCount);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> totalParagraphs = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._buffer.Sum(x =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> x.ParagraphCount);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> output = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            总词数 </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> totalWords,
            总段落数 </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> totalParagraphs,
            统计时间 </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DateTimeOffset.UtcNow
        };
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> response = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>._aggregationAgent.RunAsync(JsonSerializer.Serialize(output), <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">._thread, cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> context.YieldOutputAsync(response.Text, cancellationToken);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h2><strong><span>构建工作流</span></strong></h2>
<p>现在万事俱备，只欠一个Workflow，现在Let's do it!</p>
<p><strong>Step1: </strong>获取ChatClient</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> chatClient = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OpenAIClient(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ApiKeyCredential(openAIProvider.ApiKey),
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> OpenAIClientOptions { Endpoint = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Uri(openAIProvider.Endpoint) })
    .GetChatClient(openAIProvider.ModelId)
    .AsIChatClient();</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong><span><span>Step2<span>: </span></span></span></strong>实例化自定义Agent &amp; Executors</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> fileRead = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FileReadExecutor();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> wordCounting = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WordCountingExecutor();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> paragraphCounting = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ParagraphCountingExecutor();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> aggregate = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> AggregationExecutor(chatClient);</pre>
</div>
<p><strong><span><span>Step3<span>:</span></span></span></strong> 创建Fan-out/Fan-in工作流</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> sharedStateWorkflow = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WorkflowBuilder(fileRead)
    .AddFanOutEdge(fileRead, [wordCounting, paragraphCounting])
    .AddFanInEdge([wordCounting, paragraphCounting], aggregate)
    .WithOutputFrom(aggregate)
    .Build();

Console.OutputEncoding </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Encoding.UTF8;
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ Shared State Workflow 构建完成</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p><span><strong>Step4</strong><span><strong>:</strong> 测试工作流</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> documentKey = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ProductBrief</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">📂 演示文档: {documentKey}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> run = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InProcessExecution.StreamAsync(sharedStateWorkflow, documentKey))
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (WorkflowEvent evt <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> run.WatchStreamAsync())
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">switch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (evt)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WorkflowStartedEvent started:
                Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🚀 Workflow Started</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ExecutorCompletedEvent executorCompleted:
                Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ {executorCompleted.ExecutorId} 完成</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WorkflowOutputEvent outputEvent:
                Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🎉 工作流执行完成</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{outputEvent.Data}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">case</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WorkflowErrorEvent errorEvent:
                Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✨ 收到 Workflow Error Event：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{errorEvent.Data}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        }
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> run.DisposeAsync();
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>测试结果如下图所示：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202512/381412-20251217190544706-255281045.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>可以看见，经过多个节点的统计和聚合，由LLM总结输出了用户友好的统计结果内容。</p>
<h1><strong><span>小结</span></strong></h1>
<p>本文介绍了工作流的状态共享的应用场景 和 WorkflowContext相关的API，最后给出了一个文档内容统计的Fan-out/Fan-In工作流案例供参考。</p>
<p>下一篇，我们将继续学习MAF中工作流的上下文相关内容。</p>
